name: whipplescript-runtime-worker
description: Cloudflare Worker + Durable Object shell for the sans-IO WhippleScript runtime (DR-0033).

scripts.deploy:harness: npm run build:wasm && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.harness.toml
scripts.deploy:edge-staging: npm run build:wasm && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.edge-staging.toml
scripts.deploy:private-production: npm run build:wasm && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.private-production.toml
scripts.dev: npm run build:wasm && wrangler dev --config wrangler.harness.toml
scripts.build:executor: cargo build --release -p whipplescript --bin whip && cp ../../../target/release/whip executor/whip
scripts.prepare:executor:norm: cargo run --release -p whipplescript --bin whip -- executor prepare-norm-runtime-context --request
scripts.test: npm run contracts:check && npm run canaries:check && npm run test:unit && npm run test:workerd
scripts.test:unit: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/agent-workspace-resources.test.ts src/assistant-text.test.ts src/credential-class-ref.test.ts src/executor-broker.test.ts src/executor-handoff.test.ts src/live-model-context.test.ts src/model-broker.test.ts src/private-home-protocol.test.ts src/provider-realization.test.ts src/session-lifecycle.test.ts src/session-collection.test.ts src/object-store.test.ts
scripts.deploy:private-staging: npm run build:wasm && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.private-staging.toml
scripts.test:workerd: npm run norm:vector && npm run build:wasm && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config vitest.authenticated.config.ts
scripts.capture:collection-vector: COLLECTION_VECTOR_OUT=${COLLECTION_VECTOR_OUT:-collection-emitted-vector.json} vitest run --config vitest.config.ts -t 'emits only declared paths'
scripts.deploy:public: npm run build:wasm && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.public.toml
